browser_console_messages.description: Return buffered console logs for the current or specified tab. Clear-and-return by default.

clear.description: If true, clear buffer after returning. Default true.

tab_handle.description: Optional; defaults to current browsing context.

browser_dialogs.description: List and respond to browser dialogs. Actions: "list" to query, "respond" to accept, "dismiss" to cancel. For JS prompt dialogs, provide inputText.

close_tab.description: Close a browser tab by its handle.

handle.description: Handle of the tab to close.

create_tab.description: Create a new browser tab, optionally loading a URL. Returns the UUID and info of the new tab.

url.description: Optional URL to load in the new tab.

evaluate_javascript.description: Execute a JavaScript function body within the page. The script may contain multiple statements; add an explicit `return` for any value you want back. Use `$uid(N)` to reference DOM elements by their UID from get_page_content output (e.g. `return $uid(42).href`). When `frameId` is set, runs inside the frame that UID belongs to. Prefer get_page_content for reading page text or structure — reach for it with `region: "entire_page"` or relaxed filters before scripting a DOM scrape here. Reserve this tool for actions or computations that text extraction can't express.

expression.description: JavaScript code to evaluate, treated as a function body. Use an explicit `return` for a value. Supports $uid(N) macros.

frameId.description: UID of a node from get_page_content output, identifying a subframe to run in instead of the main frame: pass an iframe's UID to run inside that iframe, or the UID of a node inside a subframe to run in that subframe. Omit this to run in the main frame.

get_network_request.description: Return full detail for a single recorded network request (headers, body when text and within size cap, timing).

request_id.description: Inspector request id, as returned by list_network_requests.

get_page_content.description: Extract the text content of a page using WebKit's text extraction. This is the preferred way to read a page — favor it over screenshots or scripting the DOM with evaluate_javascript. If the content you need is missing, widen the extraction (e.g. `region: "entire_page"`, a larger `maxWordsPerParagraph`, or relaxed node/URL filters) before reaching for those tools. Use the returned node UIDs (e.g. `uid=42`) with `page_interactions` and `evaluate_javascript` (`$uid(42)`). Output ≥ 32 kB is saved to a temp file; the path is returned. Pass `savePath` to always write to disk.

format.description: Output format (default: "textTree"). "text" is an alias for "textTree".

includeAccessibilityAttributes.description: Include accessibility attributes like role/aria-label (default: true).

includeEventListeners.description: Include click/hover/touch event listener info (default: false).

includeRects.description: Include bounding rects for text nodes (default: false).

includeSubframes.description: Also extract content from cross-origin subframes (default: false).

includeURLs.description: Include URL attributes like href/src (default: true).

maxWordsPerParagraph.description: Truncate paragraphs to this many words (default: 15). Use a larger value when you need full prose; smaller saves tokens.

nodeIds.description: Which nodes get UIDs (default: "interactive"; ignored when format is "markdown" or "plainText").

region.description: Extraction region (default: "viewport"). Use "entire_page" to capture beyond the visible scrollport.

savePath.description: File path to write the extraction to. When set, the path is returned instead of inline content.

shortenURLs.description: Strip query params and noise from URLs (default: true).

list_network_requests.description: List network request summaries (URL, method, status, timing) recorded by Inspector for the current or specified tab.

clear.description: If true, drain and reset the per-tab buffer.

status_max.description: Inclusive upper bound on response status.

status_min.description: Inclusive lower bound on response status.

since.description: ISO8601 timestamp; only requests started at or after this time are returned.

tab_handle.description: Browsing-context handle. Defaults to active tab.

list_tabs.description: List all open browser tabs with their handles, titles, and URLs.

navigate_to_url.description: Navigate to a URL and return the loaded page's extracted content. Auto-creates a tab if none is open, waits for the navigation to complete, and uses the format/options from the most recent get_page_content call (or sensible defaults). Output ≥ 32 kB is saved to a temp file.

handle.description: Handle of the tab to navigate. If omitted, uses the active tab.

page_info.description: Get information about the current page including URL, title, and loading state.

page_interactions.description: Perform DOM interactions in sequence. Actions: click, type, keyPress, scroll, selectText, selectMenuItem, hover, highlightText. **Prefer batch mode** whenever possible — provide all related interactions in a single call instead of separate calls (faster, single round-trip, single diff). Returns a diff of page changes after the batch (or full text if >50% changed); pass `fullText: true` to disable diffing. If a click triggers a navigation, the tool waits for it to finish and returns the loaded page's content. The diff/full text uses the format set by the most recent `get_page_content` call. Output ≥ 32 kB is saved to a temp file. Reference elements by node UID from `get_page_content`; fall back to `text` for find-in-page when no UID is available.

fullText.description: Return the full updated page text instead of a diff (default: false).

interactions.description: Sequence of interactions, executed sequentially with a 400 ms settle between each.

node.description: Node UID from get_page_content output. When omitted, `text` is treated as a find-in-page search; when both are set, the search is scoped to the subtree under `node`.

point.description: Viewport coordinates. Last resort when node and text are unavailable.

pressReturn.description: For `type`: simulate Return after typing to submit (default: false).

purpose.description: Short description of the intended outcome.

replaceAll.description: For `type`: replace existing field text instead of appending (default: false).

scrollToVisible.description: Scroll the target element into view before interacting (default: false).

text.description: Find-in-page query, scroll search term, or menu item label. Optional when `node` is provided.

value.description: Text to type, or key name to press.

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of the current page and save it as a PNG. Returns the file path (never inline base64). Defaults to the visible viewport; pass `full_page: true` for the entire scrollable page. Pass `savePath` to write to a specific location, otherwise the PNG is saved to a temporary file. Prefer get_page_content for reading a page — its text extraction is cheaper and more reliable than reading a screenshot. Use this only when the visual rendering itself matters (e.g. layout, charts, or verifying appearance).

full_page.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the viewport.

node.description: Node UID from get_page_content output to capture only that element. (Currently no-op pending dispatcher support; falls back to viewport.)

savePath.description: File path to write the PNG to. If omitted, the PNG is written to a temporary file.

set_emulated_media.description: Emulate a CSS media type (e.g. "screen" or "print") for responsive-design testing.

media.description: CSS media type to emulate, e.g. "screen" or "print". Empty string clears the override.

set_viewport_size.description: Set the browser viewport size in CSS pixels.

switch_tab.description: Switch to a different browser tab by its handle.

handle.description: Handle of the tab to switch to.

wait_for_navigation.description: Wait for the current page to finish loading. Returns the final URL and title.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

dblClick.description: Set to true for double clicks. Default is false.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

close_page.description: Closes the page by its index. The last open page cannot be closed.

pageId.description: The ID of the page to close. Call list_pages to list pages.

drag.description: Drag an element onto another element

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

from_uid.description: The uid of the element to drag

to_uid.description: The uid of the element to drop into

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

emulate.description: Emulates various features on the target page.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Omit to disable throttling.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Omit or set the rate to 1 to disable throttling

geolocation.description: Geolocation (`<latitude>,<longitude>`) to emulate. Latitude between -90 and 90. Longitude between -180 and 180. Omit to clear the geolocation override.

userAgent.description: User agent to emulate. Set to empty string to clear the user agent override.

colorScheme.description: Emulate the dark or the light mode. Set to "auto" to reset to the default.

viewport.description: Emulate device viewports '<width>x<height>x<devicePixelRatio>[,mobile][,touch][,landscape]'. 'touch' and 'mobile' to emulate mobile devices. 'landscape' to emulate landscape mode.

extraHttpHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers as a JSON string object, e.g. {"X-Custom": "value", "Authorization": "Bearer token"}. Headers are included into every HTTP request originating from the page and persist across navigations until cleared. Pass an empty string to clear all extra headers.

evaluate_script.description: Evaluate a JavaScript function inside the target page. Returns the response as JSON, so returned values have to be JSON-serializable.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

function.description:
A JavaScript function declaration to be executed by the tool in the target page.
Example without arguments: `() => document.title` or `async () => await fetch("example.com")`.
Example with arguments: `(el) => el.innerText`

items.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

args.description: An optional list of arguments to pass to the function.

filePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a file to save the script output to. If omitted, the output is returned inline.

dialogAction.description: Handle dialogs while execution. "accept", "dismiss", or string for response of window.prompt. Defaults to accept.

waitForStableDom.description: Whether to wait for the DOM to settle. Pass false if the script only reads data. Defaults to true.

fill.description: Type text into an input, text area or select an option from a <select> element.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

value.description: The value to fill in. "true" or "false" for checkboxes and toggles, "true" for radio buttons.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

fill_form.description: Fill out multiple form elements (inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios) at once. ALWAYS prefer this tool over multiple individual 'fill' or 'click' calls when interacting with forms. It is significantly faster, more reliable, and reduces turn count. Example: Fill username, password, and check "Remember Me" in one call.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of the element to fill out

value.description: Value for the element. "true" or "false" for checkboxes and toggles, "true" for radio buttons.

elements.description: Elements from snapshot to fill out.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

get_console_message.description: Gets a console message by its ID. You can get all messages by calling list_console_messages.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

msgid.description: The msgid of a console message on the page from the listed console messages

get_network_request.description: Gets a network request by an optional reqid, if omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

reqid.description: The reqid of the network request. If omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

requestFilePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a .network-request file to save the request body to. If omitted, the body is returned inline.

responseFilePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a .network-response file to save the response body to. If omitted, the body is returned inline.

handle_dialog.description: If a browser dialog was opened, use this command to handle it

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

action.description: Whether to dismiss or accept the dialog

promptText.description: Optional prompt text to enter into the dialog.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

lighthouse_audit.description: Get Lighthouse score and reports for accessibility, SEO, best practices, and agentic browsing. This excludes performance. For performance audits, run performance_start_trace

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

outputDirPath.description: Directory for reports. If omitted, uses temporary files.

list_console_messages.description: List all console messages for the target page since the last navigation.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, returns all messages.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

types.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all messages.

includePreservedMessages.description: Set to true to return the preserved messages over the last 3 navigations.

includeStackTraces.description: Set to true to include the stack trace for each message when available. Increases the response size.

serviceWorkerId.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified service worker.

list_network_requests.description: Lists the most recent requests for the target page since the last navigation.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return. When omitted, returns all requests.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

resourceTypes.description: Filter requests to only return requests of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all requests.

includePreservedRequests.description: Set to true to return the preserved requests over the last 3 navigations.

list_pages.description: Get a list of pages open in the browser.

navigate_page.description: Go to a URL, or back, forward, or reload. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

type.description: Navigate the page by URL, back or forward in history, or reload.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore cache on reload.

handleBeforeUnload.description: Whether to auto accept or beforeunload dialogs triggered by this navigation. Default is accept.

initScript.description: A JavaScript script to be executed on each new document before any other scripts for the next navigation.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

new_page.description: Open a new tab and load a URL. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

background.description: Whether to open the page in the background without bringing it to the front. Default is false (foreground).

isolatedContext.description: If specified, the page is created in an isolated browser context with the given name. Pages in the same browser context share cookies and storage. Pages in different browser contexts are fully isolated.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

performance_analyze_insight.description: Provides more detailed information on a specific Performance Insight of an insight set that was highlighted in the results of a trace recording.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

insightSetId.description: The id for the specific insight set. Only use the ids given in the "Available insight sets" list.

insightName.description: The name of the Insight you want more information on. For example: "DocumentLatency" or "LCPBreakdown"

performance_start_trace.description: Start a performance trace on the target webpage. Use to find frontend performance issues, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), and improve page load speed.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

reload.description: Determines if, once tracing has started, the target page should be automatically reloaded. Navigate the page to the right URL using the navigate_page tool BEFORE starting the trace if reload or autoStop is set to true.

autoStop.description: Determines if the trace recording should be automatically stopped.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

performance_stop_trace.description: Stop the active performance trace recording on the target webpage.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

press_key.description: Press a key or key combination. Use this when other input methods like fill() cannot be used (e.g., keyboard shortcuts, navigation keys, or special key combinations).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

key.description: A key or a combination (e.g., "Enter", "Control+A", "Control++", "Control+Shift+R"). Modifiers: Control, Shift, Alt, Meta

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

resize_page.description: Resizes the page's window so that the page has specified dimension

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

select_page.description: Select a page as a context for future tool calls.

pageId.description: The ID of the page to select. Call list_pages to get available pages.

bringToFront.description: Whether to focus the page and bring it to the top.

take_heapsnapshot.description: Capture a heap snapshot of the target page. Use to analyze the memory distribution of JavaScript objects and debug memory leaks.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

filePath.description: A path to a .heapsnapshot file to save the heapsnapshot to.

take_screenshot.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

format.description: Type of format to save the screenshot as. Default is "png"

quality.description: Compression quality for JPEG and WebP formats (0-100). Higher values mean better quality but larger file sizes. Ignored for PNG format.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot. If omitted, takes a page screenshot.

fullPage.description: If set to true takes a screenshot of the full page instead of the currently visible viewport. Incompatible with uid.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the screenshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

take_snapshot.description:
Take a text snapshot of the target page based on the a11y tree. The snapshot lists page elements along with a unique
identifier (uid). Always use the latest snapshot. Prefer taking a snapshot over taking a screenshot. The snapshot indicates the element selected
in the DevTools Elements panel (if any).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

verbose.description: Whether to include all possible information available in the full a11y tree. Default is false.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the snapshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

type_text.description: Type text using keyboard into a previously focused input

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

submitKey.description: Optional key to press after typing. E.g., "Enter", "Tab", "Escape"

upload_file.description: Upload a file through a provided element.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of the file input element or an element that will open file chooser on the page from the page content snapshot

filePaths.description: One or more files paths to upload. File paths have to be local to the browser instance (not the MCP).

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

wait_for.description: Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

text.description: Non-empty list of texts. Resolves when any value appears on the page.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.
